prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Edit the supplied NPC concept sheet for a revised visual approval mockup. Preserve its detailed hand-painted retro fantasy rendering, warm light, material textures, character identity, exact wardrobe and colors, and layout: four full standing cardinal views (front, screen-left profile, back, screen-right profile) and one larger expression portrait at right. Preserve transparent background, full bodies, same scale and baseline, clear gutters. No labels, text, extra figures, props or scenery. Apply the requested anatomical revision coherently to all views including portrait. This is a targeted refinement, not a new character design.
Requested revision: The mayor should be a believable very obese angry middle-aged human, mildly comic rather than grotesque. Keep the huge belly, round flushed face, bald crown and gray side hair, tiny crown, elaborate burgundy/purple robe and angry attitude. Substantially dial down facial ugliness: reduce swollen nose and exaggerated face folds, soften the purple temple veins to subtle natural veins, make eyes and brow anatomically human. Reduce gaping scream to a believable open-mouthed angry complaint. Use normal-sized mostly intact teeth, mild unevenness only, no conspicuous black gaps or rotten-looking teeth, no extreme exposed gums. Jaw projection only subtle. Keep him recognizably the same pompous mayor, not handsome or slim, but no monstrous anatomy or body-horror effect.
